youtube_title: Only 5 Free ATM Uses a Month, Then Up to Rs 23 Each. Rules You Didn't Know #14 #Shorts
youtube_description:
RULES YOU DIDN'T KNOW #14. Rs 23 quietly cut after an ATM withdrawal? How many free ATM transactions do you get at your own bank's ATM each month? A: unlimited. B: only 5.
Answer: B. RBI rules: 5 free transactions a month at your own bank's ATMs; at other banks' ATMs 3 free in metro centres and 5 in non-metro centres. Balance checks and other non-financial transactions count too. After the free limit a bank can charge up to Rs 23 per transaction (from 1 May 2025), plus taxes. Tip: fewer, bigger withdrawals and check your balance on the app.
Source: RBI circular on ATM charges (updated 28 Mar 2025).
